newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 42.5250/5380 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous close at 42.5420/5430, dealers said.
The local unit was stronger in early trade at 42.5320/5420 per dollar and edged up further after banks offered large volume of U.S. currency in the market.
"It was a buyers' market today. Most banks tried to offload dollars which they have received from wage earners and export proceeds," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates finished flat at 5.0 to 5.5 percent, dealers said.
